speaker: Leonard
text: What's with the fish? What happened to your scrambled egg research?

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's an experiment. Oh, that was a dead end. The scrambled eggs are as good as they're ever going to be.

speaker: Sheldon
text: I read an article about Japanese scientists who inserted DNA from luminous jellyfish into other animals, and I thought, hey, fish nightlights.

speaker: Leonard
text: Shh. I'm so bored. Sheldon, are you sure you don't want to just apologize to Gablehauser and get your job back?

speaker: Sheldon
text: No, no, no. Oh, I have too much to do.

speaker: Leonard
text: Like luminous fish. Shh. Sorry, I didn't.

speaker: Sheldon
text: That's just the beginning. I also have an idea for a bulk male or feminine hygiene company. Oh, glow in the dark tampons.

speaker: Leonard
text: Thanks for coming on such short notice. I didn't know what else to do. He's lost all focus. Every day he's got a new obsession.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You did the right thing, Colin.
